three_readings_for_the_desk.1_the_verdict_block_is_computed_on_the_w: bag-511.json's verdict block carries board_all_row_s 0.07563 -- the IN-FOLD figure -- and on it reports inside_the_registered_band false and the_registered_expectation_holds false.  But the gate the desk ruled on is the CROSS-FITTED reading, +0.01668 [-0.01829, +0.04705], and that IS inside the registered [-0.04, +0.04] with every_fold_interval_clear false.  Read on the gate's own reading, 40.1's prediction HELD, and it held in detail: it named july as the fold most likely to fail, and july is exactly the fold whose interval straddles zero.  Recorded as a correction offered before 40.1 is committed, not as a challenge to the ruling, which is unaffected: the gate fails either way and there is no v8 serve.
three_readings_for_the_desk.2_the_resolution_did_not_improve_as_far_: 40.1 registered B about 38 s2/row on july and rms about 6 s, with the floor falling to roughly [-0.013, -0.011].  Measured: july B 95.15, rms 9.75 s -- 2.5x the registered energy; december 148.59 / 12.19 s; january 119.45 / 10.93 s.  So the instrument resolves better than read A's single-draw pair but not as well as the five-fold division predicted, and 'unresolved' should be recorded at the resolution actually achieved, not the one registered.
three_readings_for_the_desk.3_where_the_cross_fit_put_the_rung: out of fold, 511 was taken on july ALONE; december and january both fell back to the 255 head.  The eligibility rule judges a fold on the OTHER TWO, so it lit the one fold whose own increment straddles zero (july [-18.88, +46.57]) and blanked the two whose increments are clear and positive (december +53.72 [+20.25, +83.95], january +79.56 [+51.10, +108.79]).  The 0.0589 selection premium is exactly that collapse.  TEMPERED, and this is the honest half: december carries no board share, so of the two clear folds only january (0.4429) has board weight, and july carries 0.5571.  The rule did not throw away most of the board's evidence -- it placed the rung on the larger share, which happens to be the noisy one.  The revival condition this points at is the eligibility rule, not the capacity ladder.
